verdict.rationale: mise ships its own lockfile: the docs link a dedicated lockfile page, say to commit it and run `mise install --locked` so every job installs the same versions, and expose `mise lock --bump --dry-run --json` for machine-readable lock updates. Committing it to the repo implies it can be diffed, but the evidence never shows the file's contents or confirms it is a text format. missing for 10: evidence of the lockfile's text format and schema, explicit diff/readability guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
